name: cavalry-claude-bridge
description: Let Claude read, edit and preview your Cavalry scenes.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to Cavalry through the Stallion bridge. Claude can inspect the scene (layers, attributes, connections), change it with JavaScript, connect nodes, switch Duplicator distributions and render a frame to check the result. Requires Cavalry with Stallion running (Scripts > Stallion).

tools.name: cavalry_get_scene
tools.description: Snapshot of the scene: hierarchy, changed attributes, expressions, animation and connections.

tools.name: cavalry_execute_script
tools.description: Run JavaScript inside Cavalry and return the result, console output and errors.

tools.name: cavalry_connect
tools.description: Connect two nodes; creates missing array slots and verifies the result.

tools.name: cavalry_set_distribution
tools.description: Change a Duplicator's distribution type (circle, fibonacci, grid, ...).

tools.name: cavalry_render_frame
tools.description: Render the current frame to a PNG so Claude can see the result.

tools.name: cavalry_api_search
tools.description: Search the installed Cavalry scripting API by name.

tools.name: cavalry_help
tools.description: Short verified notes about the Cavalry API and its pitfalls, by topic.

tools.name: cavalry_get_keyframes
tools.description: Read an attribute's keyframes as {id, time, value}.

tools.name: cavalry_parent
tools.description: Parent or unparent a layer (hierarchy, not an attribute connection).

tools.name: cavalry_lookup_enum
tools.description: Resolve an enum value's human-readable label, from a bundled database first.

stallion_port.title: Stallion port
stallion_port.description: Port shown in the Stallion window in Cavalry ("Listening on 127.0.0.1:8080"). Change it only if yours is different.
